description: The authoritative, version-controlled Required_GCP_Resource_Set for the simplified cloud-minimal system (simplify-to-cloud-minimal spec R11.1, design C5). This is a POSITIVE keep-list: it enumerates ONLY the GCP resources the simplified daily loop needs in project trade-assistant-508806. Everything present in the live project that is NOT matched here is an Orphaned_GCP_Resource and is a candidate for operator-approved deletion in task 7.2. NO secret VALUE appears here — secrets are referenced by NAME only (R11.3). This manifest is diffed against a read-only live enumeration (ops/enumerate-gcp.sh); it never mutates any resource.

cloudRunJobs.name: scheduled-daily-run
cloudRunJobs.role: The daily deterministic daily-run executed unattended once per trading day (R6.1). Deployed by GitHub Actions as a SHA-pinned image; runs as the Job runtime service account.

cloudSchedulerJobs.name: scheduled-daily-run-session-close
cloudSchedulerJobs.role: EXACTLY ONE Cloud Scheduler trigger firing the Job at Session_Close (NY close), Mon-Fri (R6.2). Source of truth: ops/scheduler-job.config.json.

serviceAccounts.note: The dedicated least-privilege runtime SA the Cloud Run Job runs as (deploy.yml RUNTIME_SERVICE_ACCOUNT GitHub var; confirmed live as the SA holding roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor).
serviceAccounts.rolesNote: roles/aiplatform.user (which includes aiplatform.endpoints.predict) is required for the display-only Vertex AI Gemini rationale call and resolves the observed aiplatform.endpoints.predict 403. VERIFIED granted to this SA at the project level: project IAM policy lists roles/aiplatform.user on job-runtime@, and the IAM SetIamPolicy audit log records the binding ADDED on 2026-10-08. The gemini-2.5-flash publisher model is reachable in europe-west1 (read-only countTokens probe returned HTTP 200). Least-privilege: the project-level roles/aiplatform.user grant is the minimal predefined role carrying endpoints.predict for the publisher-model path (daily-candle-freshness-and-cleanup R7.1, R7.3).

serviceAccounts.note: Identity Cloud Scheduler uses to invoke the Job via OIDC (R6.2).
Deploy-time SA GitHub Actions impersonates via Workload Identity Federation (keyless). Builds + pushes the image, deploys the Job, publishes Hosting.
serviceAccounts.rolesNote: Minimal build/registry/deploy roles plus roles/firebasehosting.admin for the Hosting publish (R11 glossary; deploy.yml header). The exact granted role set is confirmed by the live IAM-policy enumeration; roles granted to this SA solely for removed subsystems are Orphaned bindings.

secretManagerSecrets.name: supabase-key
secretManagerSecrets.role: The single Write_Credential (R6.3, R4.6): the fx_writer scoped ES256 JWT the Job writes with. Referenced BY NAME only.

secretManagerSecrets.name: supabase-publishable-key
secretManagerSecrets.role: The publishable apikey the REST client sends alongside the Bearer write JWT (PostgREST API-gateway admission).

secretManagerSecrets.name: supabase-pooler-url
secretManagerSecrets.role: IPv4-reachable pooler/REST endpoint (Cloud Run has no IPv6 egress).

secretManagerSecrets.name: external-signal-api-key
secretManagerSecrets.role: The External_Reference_Signal provider (FCS) key the retained external-signal adapter reads at runtime (R6.3).

secretManagerSecrets.name: twelve-data-api-key
secretManagerSecrets.role: OHLC range provider (Twelve Data) — FIRST range-capable fallback in the daily Candle_Freshness_Stage Provider_Fallback_Chain (FCS -> Twelve Data -> Massive). REQUIRED: FCS is latest-only, so without a range provider a multi-day candle Gap_Backfill can never self-heal (root cause of the 2026-10-08 stuck-candle incident). Injected as TWELVE_DATA_API_KEY via deploy.yml --set-secrets. NOT an orphan.

secretManagerSecrets.name: massive-api-key
secretManagerSecrets.role: OHLC range provider (Massive) — SECOND range-capable fallback in the chain (host https://api.massive.com, Polygon-style aggregates). REQUIRED alongside twelve-data-api-key for Gap_Backfill self-healing. Injected as MASSIVE_API_KEY via deploy.yml --set-secrets. NOT an orphan.

secretManagerSecretsNote: The Gemini/Vertex AI path does NOT use a Secret Manager API-key secret: the Job calls Vertex AI with GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_VERTEXAI=true, authorized by the runtime SA's roles/aiplatform.user (R11 glossary 'the Gemini/Vertex path'). twelve-data-api-key and massive-api-key were RE-ADDED on 2026-11-03 (daily-candle-freshness-and-cleanup) as the two range-capable OHLC fallbacks the daily Candle_Freshness_Stage needs — they are REQUIRED keep-list secrets, NOT orphans. Any Secret Manager secret NOT listed above — in particular the obsolete scoped-JWT provider secrets superseded after the yields/news removals (alpha-vantage-api-key, finnhub-api-key, news-api-key, news-calendar-api-key) — is an Orphaned_GCP_Resource (R11.8), subject to operator-approved deletion in task 7.2 only after confirming no retained --set-secrets entry references it.

repositories.name: app-images
repositories.note: The single Docker repository holding the scheduled-daily-run Job images (deploy.yml AR_REPOSITORY GitHub var; image path europe-west1-docker.pkg.dev/trade-assistant-508806/app-images/scheduled-run:SHA). Confirmed live. Also currently holds Orphaned image lines: dashboard-read-proxy/*, gate-run/*, seed-run/* and scheduled-run images beyond the retention window.

retention.note: Keep only a bounded number (5) of the most recent scheduled-run Job images; older Job images and ALL read-proxy (dashboard-read-proxy) images are stale and Orphaned (R11.9). Retention enforcement is an operator-approved mutation (task 7.2), not part of the read-only enumeration.

firebaseHosting.role: The public, mobile-reachable dashboard SPA host (R6 constraint 2 / Public_Read_Path). Serves the static bundle + dashboard.json snapshot. Source of truth: web/.firebaserc, web/firebase.json.

workloadIdentityFederation.note: The pool/provider backing the keyless GitHub Actions deploy (deploy.yml WIF_PROVIDER GitHub var). Confirmed live via gcloud iam workload-identity-pools list (location=global).

orphanedExamples.note: Non-exhaustive examples of Orphaned_GCP_Resources the task-7.2 reconcile is expected to remove, derived from the removed subsystems (R11.6-R11.10). The authoritative orphan set is whatever the live enumeration finds that is NOT matched above.
artifactRegistryImages: scheduled-run images beyond the retention window
serviceAccounts: firebase-adminsdk-fbsvc@ (review if Hosting deploy only needs gh-deploy)
